source: The steady sounds of clip-clopping hooves pulling creaking carriages will be absent from the streets in Chicago starting next year after the City Council on Friday voted to ban horse-drawn carriages.

id: Under the ordinance, which is effective Jan. 1, 2021, operators will be unable to renew their licenses, and the city will stop issuing new ones.

The horse-drawn carriage industry has been shrinking for years. The city now has 10 carriage licenses that will expire at the end of the year, The Chicago Tribune reported. At one point, it had 60 licenses available, according to The Associated Press.
source: 從明年開始，芝加哥街頭將不再有馬車行駛時發出的噠噠馬蹄聲和吱呀聲，市議會於週五投票禁止了馬車。

id: 根據該條例，自2021年1月1日起生效，運營商將無法續簽執照，市政府也將停止發放新執照。
據《芝加哥論壇報》報導，馬車行業多年來一直在萎縮。該市目前有10個馬車執照將於年底到期。據美聯社報導，該市曾一度提供60個執照。
